test_title: PYST 5: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
The letter-cluster that DOES NOT belong to the group is **POT**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ff0d8e32a7e80c8a0f32fe049be66c25ff3158e027f9b919dda98d555ab272f7.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**Option 1) 'DGF':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e40be21ec619186cb2cf1eb8afdf2928f554573d5c1ec8488c382d223cdd0db2.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f4180510978721cb02a499bfbb7e9c1103f893d3e3ccab5e048e4d77caee43c.png] 

Pattern: (+3, -1). 

**Option 2) 'ORQ':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a4a5132bf76a28c11e30762b5ff13dec557bc6892e1384f31dd673318ceb919.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/42d0cae52ec33970d04ab6c887985b68b9bb153392464665e9a109debb2cce04.png] 

Pattern: (+3, -1).

**Option 3) POT**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b732917551f5f71e37744242115ef998c9ca6f929c7bc7c3acc0aa508d95c5b.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e7b7e4501e856307d1a92f21a0beaef6f72cf35fea4a398c224ffe6e6985cb87.png] 

Pattern: (-1, +5). (does not follow same pattern)

**Option 4) 'FIH':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7771c52d694eabcb438be901e5fc182e5b02d94bfdbc99acf75142600d10e726.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7619e6ef4f2a0c9aaea68feb410484ea196ff83d9064375fc11d45e408efbae1.png] 

Pattern: (+3, -1). 

Thus, the letter-cluster that DOES NOT belong to that group is POT.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
